segments.text: Subhas Chandra Bose was born on 23rd January 1897 to Janaki Bose, a well-reputed Advocate, and Prabhavati Devi.
Subhas Chandra Bose's nationalist temperament first came to light at the Presidency College, Kolkata.
He was rusticated for assaulting Professor Oaten for his anti-India comments.
